name: ui-select
prompt: Short bright UI confirmation click: a quick metallic tap with a soft high blip, clean and dry, no reverb tail.

name: ui-back
prompt: Short soft UI back sound: a muted descending wooden tick, like a small toggle switch flicked down.

name: ui-error
prompt: Short dull error buzz: two low muted thuds on a plastic panel, flat and disapproving, no high frequencies.

name: spawn
prompt: Object materializing pop: a quick wooden knock with an airy snap, like a block snapping into place on a workbench.

name: joint
prompt: Small mechanical pin locking: two quick metal snaps like a hinge pin clicking into a socket.

name: delete
prompt: Soft crumpling whoosh: tearing cardboard with a short puff of air, muffled and quick.

name: undo
prompt: Quick reverse whoosh: a tape-rewind slide ending in a single soft tick.

name: run-start
prompt: Machinery spin-up: a rising mechanical whirr of gears engaging, ending with a solid clunk.

name: impact
prompt: Heavy physics impact: a solid steel weight hitting a wooden plank, deep thud with a short metallic ring.

name: shatter
prompt: Glass pane shattering into many small shards scattering on a hard concrete floor.

name: goal
prompt: Cheerful success chime: two bright glockenspiel notes rising, like a small service bell rung twice.

name: win
prompt: Short triumphant fanfare: bright brass and bells rising through four celebratory notes, warm and satisfying.

name: lose
prompt: Sad descending trombone phrase: three soft low muted notes falling in pitch, gentle and comical.

name: tick
prompt: Single high clock tick: one small precise metallic click, very short and dry.

name: pause
prompt: Soft pause sound: a muted latch clicking shut with a gentle downward thunk.

name: achievement
prompt: Sparkling magical chime arpeggio: three bright crystalline bell notes ascending with a shimmer.
